faq.q: What are the cheapest no-license boat rental prices in Marbella for 2035?

faq.q: What is included in the no-license boat rental price?

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental no license prices 2035? You're in the right place. Whether you're dreaming of cruising the Costa del Sol without a boating licence or just want a hassle-free day on the water, this guide covers current rates, boat options, and what to expect when you charter from Puerto Banús. With prices starting from €749 for 2 hours on a 12.5m yacht, you can enjoy the Mediterranean without the paperwork.

Why Choose a No-License Boat Rental in Marbella?

No-license charters are the easiest way to explore Marbella's coastline. You don't need any qualifications – just show up, meet your skipper, and relax. All our boats come with a licensed captain who handles navigation, mooring, and safety. This means you can focus on swimming, sunbathing, and sipping cava while someone else drives. It's perfect for families, groups of friends, or corporate events where you want zero stress.

Marbella Boat Rental No License Prices 2035: Tier A

Our most affordable no-license options are the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include everything you need for a perfect day out.

  • 2-hour charter: €749
  • 4-hour charter: €1,299
  • 6-hour charter: €1,799
  • 8-hour charter: €2,299

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% VAT. No hidden extras.

Marbella Boat Rental No License Prices 2035: Tier B

For a larger experience, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) and its grey variant offer a minimum 4-hour charter from €4,719. This includes a free jet ski – a fantastic bonus for thrill-seekers. The Mangusta 80 is a head-turner, perfect for making an impression along the Golden Mile or anchoring off Cabopino.

Other Boats and Pricing

We also offer a wide range of other no-license boats, including the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax), Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), and smaller options like the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax). For pricing on these, please contact us via WhatsApp – we'll provide a custom quote based on your preferred duration and boat.

What's Included in Every Charter?

Every no-license rental includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

You just need to bring sunscreen, towels, and your swimwear. The skipper will suggest a route – popular spots include Puerto Banús, Marbella Marina, Cabopino, Estepona, and Sotogrande. You can also anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim.

How to Book Your No-License Charter

Booking is simple. Visit our homepage or contact us directly via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 1-2 weeks in advance for summer 2035. For the best availability, especially on the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58, earlier is better. Payment is secure, and cancellations are free up to 48 hours before departure.

Frequently Asked Questions

No, for many boats in our fleet you don't need a license. What is included in the no-license boat rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). There are no hidden fees – the price you see is the price you pay.
